Function reference

Systems

Build, read and write a system; the example systems.

ms_system()
Build a multispecies fleet system from tables
read_ms_system()
Read a system from CSV tables
write_ms_system()
Write a system to CSV tables
ms_landscape()
Catchability from a habitat landscape
atlantic_system()
Atlantic example system
got_system_draft()
Gulf of Thailand system (draft)
got_species()
Gulf of Thailand species groups (mmsyapp input)

Calibration

ms_tune()
Tune daily costs so that a target fleet composition is an open-access equilibrium
ms_condition()
Condition stock status on target depletions
ms_open_access() ms_status_quo()
Open-access and status-quo equilibria

Simulation and equilibrium

ms_simulate()
Simulate the system forward
ms_summary()
Summaries over the kept years
ms_closure()
Fixed metier closures
ms_yield_curve()
Equilibrium yield curve over effort
ms_shared_q_curve()
Shared-q yield curve (the mmsyapp model)
ms_optimise()
Maximise an equilibrium objective over segment effort caps
allocate_effort()
Allocate segment effort to metiers
ffmsy()
F relative to Fmsy in the discrete Schaefer model

Harvest strategies

hcr_effort()
Segment effort rule with an optional choke-stock closure
ms_assessment_presets()
Default assessment strategies: indicator species, complexes and assignment
ms_tune_hcr()
Tune the triggers of hcr_effort() to a risk criterion
proc_sd_from_r()
Process SD by productivity: a power law in r through two anchors
relsig_jabba()
JABBA proc.dyn relative process SD

Performance statistics

ms_perf()
Performance statistics in the mseviz format
ms_statistics()
Definitions of the performance statistics
ms_perf_table()
Summary (decision) table of performance statistics
perf_rows() ms_performance()
Performance statistics of projection runs

Plots

plot_kobe()
Kobe plot of equilibrium states
plot_catchability()
Catchability heatmap
plot_landscape()
Plot a habitat landscape
plot_yield_curves()
Equilibrium yield curves
plot_projection()
Projections by stock: B/Bmsy, F/Fmsy or catch over time
plot_fleet()
Projections of days by segment and total yield
plot_bps()
Boxplots of performance statistics by management procedure
plot_tradeoffs()
Trade-off plots of performance statistics
plot_quilt()
Quilt plot: a colour-coded decision table
theme_ms() ms_cols ms_ink
Colours and theme of the package plots

App

run_app()
Launch the mmsyFM Shiny app
